description: Simulated gaussian data with a logical regressor b and a logical partitioning variable zb: y_lreg has a planted split at z1 = 5 (zb is noise), y_lsplit a planted split on zb.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 500L
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), b = runif(n) < 0.4, z1 = runif(n, 0, 10), zb = runif(n) < 0.5)
    e <- rnorm(n)
    d$y_lreg <- ifelse(d$z1 <= 5, 1 + 2 * d$x + 1 * d$b, -1 + 0.5 * d$x - 1 * d$b) + e
    d$y_lsplit <- ifelse(d$zb, 1 + 2 * d$x, -1 - d$x) + e
    d
}
